title: Online check-in is open
description: Tell passengers that online check-in is open, with flight number and departure time. Utility WhatsApp template for airlines.
notes: Send 24 hours before departure. A direct check-in link is the one call to action you need.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, online check-in for flight *{{flight}}* departing {{date}} at {{time}} is now open. Check in now to pick your seat and get your boarding pass.
